Pricing

A subscription for deployment and fleet management, with configurable reporting and storage.

Proposed prices, not a binding tariff. The testnet preview is free. Final terms are set in your order; no complete mainnet bill has been measured. Read the business plan.

Platform plan

USD per device per month, graduated: each band applies only to the devices in it.

Monthly minimum: $49.00. Activation: $0.10 per device, one-time. Annual prepay: 10% discount on the platform charge after the minimum; data charges are separate.

Included and configurable settings

Enrollment, staged rollouts and the dashboard are included. Live telemetry is outside the base product. Log uploads are off for new fleets; the included archive settings apply when enabled. Faster checks, health reports, longer retention and encrypted delivery can add cost. Settings are chosen per fleet and recorded on chain.

Fleet data

Includes 10 MB written per device per month, kept for 42 days. Additional writes: $0.10 per GB; storage: $0.05 per GB-month. Logs count as device data. Reading data back has no Walrus egress fee.

What you pay on the networks

The all-in subscription proposal funds the fleet network budget, so customers need not hold SUI or WAL. For customer-funded arrangements, SUI pays on-chain transactions, storage deposits and gas float through the fleet budget; WAL pays Walrus artifact and device-data writes and retention. Release uploads can also require SUI relay fees. Volume rates below about $0.07 per device assume customer-funded SUI network costs. The console shows subscription prices separately from estimated network costs; they are not a second subscription charge. Provider services and actual workloads can change the total.

Estimate your fleet settings and network costs in the console. Deployment-specific price overrides may differ from this public proposal.

SUI price and renewals

Prices stay fixed in USD for the term. When a prepaid annual invoice is paid, the proposal buys 100% of the term’s estimated SUI quantity. This protects that quantity against token-price rises; gas-price or workload increases can still require more SUI. If the USD cost of SUI operations at renewal is at least 3× the quote basis, the renewal is requoted with at least 30 days’ notice. Prices never change mid-term, and falling SUI prices do not automatically reduce them.
